response.overview: Short on money, college student Sarang takes a high-paying part-time job as a “Cupid,” arranging seemingly accidental encounters to make people fall in love. After becoming one of the agency’s top performers, she receives a new assignment: Taeyang, the guy she has secretly loved for years. Unable to accept that she must match him with another woman, Sarang sabotages their meetings. But when the deadline arrives, she learns the truth—Taeyang has loved her all along, and the woman she tried to keep away from him was actually another Cupid assigned to bring Sarang and Taeyang together.
response.title: Part-Time Cupid
